# Ergo Frontier Exchange

> Decentralized peer-to-peer ERG exchange. Trade ERG for fiat (USD/EUR) directly with other users, secured by Ergo smart contract escrow and an independent verification network. No KYC, no middleman, 1% fee.

The Ergo Frontier Exchange enables trustless peer-to-peer trading of ERG (Ergo cryptocurrency) for fiat currency. Sellers lock ERG in smart contract escrow, buyers send fiat payment via Revolut/Wise/PayPal, and a decentralized verification network of independent verifiers confirms payment receipt before releasing funds. The platform also offers a Celaut Nodo program where users can earn ERG by sharing compute resources on the decentralized AI network.

## Core Features

- **P2P ERG Trading**: Buy and sell ERG directly with other users using fiat payment methods (Revolut, Wise, PayPal)
- **Smart Contract Escrow**: ERG is locked in Ergo blockchain smart contracts until payment is cryptographically verified
- **Verification Network**: 5 independent verifiers per trade, 3/5 consensus required to release funds
- **No KYC**: Connect your Nautilus wallet and start trading — no registration, no identity verification
- **Low Fees**: Only 1% network fee covering smart contract execution and verifier rewards
- **Celaut Nodo Compute**: Earn ERG passively by running a Celaut Nodo and sharing CPU/RAM on the decentralized compute network

## How Trading Works

1. Connect your Nautilus wallet
2. Browse verified seller offers on the exchange
3. Send fiat payment to seller via Revolut/Wise/PayPal
4. Verification network confirms payment (2-5 minutes)
5. Smart contract releases ERG to your wallet

## Technology

- Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Deployed on Cloudflare Pages
- Ergo blockchain smart contracts (ErgoScript)
- Nautilus wallet integration
- Decentralized verification network with cryptographic proofs
